messages.content: I need one final driving schedule for the July beach trip. The Birmingham confirmation now says arrivals after 10:00 p.m. need to be arranged, and Hotel Folly sent a reminder that its desk closes at 8:00. Can you reconcile all three bookings, what we still owe, and when we should leave each place?

Yes. I have the route as Dallas to Hoover on July 11, Hoover to Hotel Folly on July 12, Hotel Folly to Conyers on July 18, and Conyers back to Dallas on July 19. Before I set the times, does the Hotel Folly notice provide an after-hours check-in method, or does it say to call?

It says to call by 6:00 p.m. if arrival will be after 8:00. We should be there well before then. The Birmingham reservation still has our 10:30 p.m. estimate, but I don't know whether that note is enough.

The note does not override the stated 10:00 p.m. arrangement requirement, so Courtyard Birmingham Hoover should be called before departure. Ask the hotel to confirm that the room will be held for a 10:30 p.m. arrival and to place the late-arrival approval on the reservation. Hotel Folly does not need a call if you follow a schedule that gets you there before 8:00 p.m.
Build the schedule with normal meal and fuel breaks. We are not trying to make a marathon out of the Dallas day.

For Friday, July 11, I would leave Dallas at 10:00 a.m. Central. Allow about 10 hours 15 minutes of driving plus roughly 2 hours for stops. A workable sequence is lunch and fuel near Shreveport around 12:45 p.m., a short fuel and restroom stop near Jackson around 5:15 p.m., and dinner near Meridian around 7:15 p.m. That puts you at the Courtyard in Hoover at approximately 10:15 to 10:30 p.m. Central, with some protection for ordinary traffic.
Could we leave at 9:30 instead? I would rather not have one traffic delay turn into an 11:00 arrival.

A 9:30 a.m. departure is better. Keep the same stops and expect Hoover around 9:45 to 10:15 p.m. Central. The hotel should still be contacted because the upper end crosses its 10:00 p.m. threshold. If traffic is running well, you may arrive just before it.
What is the next day? We do not need to get to the beach at check-in time, but I want time to eat and unload before the desk closes.

Leave Hoover at 9:30 a.m. Central on July 12. Stop for an early lunch and fuel around LaGrange, Georgia, near noon Eastern, then take a shorter restroom or fuel break around Augusta at about 3:15 p.m. Eastern. With the time-zone change included, the drive should reach Hotel Folly around 6:15 to 6:45 p.m. Eastern. That leaves more than an hour before the 8:00 p.m. desk closure for check-in and unloading.
Good. Now check the money against the actual confirmations, including parking. I do not want the deposit counted twice.

The records reconcile as follows: Courtyard Birmingham Hoover is $184.86 total, payable at check-in. Hotel Folly has $2,157.36 in mandatory hotel charges; the $659.12 deposit is already paid, leaving $1,498.24 at the destination when the $180 parking charge is included. La Quinta Atlanta Conyers is $162.63 total, payable at check-in. The remaining lodging and parking payments across the trip are therefore $1,845.73. The prior deposit is not included again.
Break out the Folly number one more time. The confirmation separates the room balance and parking.

Hotel Folly's unpaid room-and-tax balance is $1,318.24. Parking is another $180, payable at the property. Together, those produce the $1,498.24 destination balance. Adding the paid $659.12 deposit returns to the confirmed $2,157.36 total mandatory hotel cost.
And the security amount is not part of that, correct?

Correct. The Hotel Folly record does not list a security deposit as part of the $2,157.36 mandatory total. Any incidental authorization taken at check-in would be a temporary hold rather than another trip charge, but the confirmation should be checked at the desk for the amount because none is stated in the record we have.
Plan July 18 to Conyers. Checkout is 11:00, and we would like lunch before getting on the road. Our arrival note says 9:30 p.m., which now sounds much later than necessary.

Check out by 11:00 a.m. Eastern, have lunch locally, and leave the Folly Beach area around 12:30 p.m. The drive to Conyers is about 4 hours 45 minutes before stops. One fuel and restroom break near Columbia around 2:45 p.m. should put you at La Quinta around 6:00 to 6:30 p.m. Eastern. The existing 9:30 p.m. note causes no problem, but you can update the hotel with the earlier estimate if convenient.
Do we need to call La Quinta, or only Birmingham?

Only Birmingham requires a call based on the stated arrival rules. Hotel Folly requires contact only if the July 12 ETA slips past 8:00 p.m.; if that happens, call by 6:00 p.m. La Quinta already has the arrival note, and the revised 6:00 to 6:30 p.m. estimate is within a normal check-in window.
Finish with Conyers to Dallas and give me a realistic fuel estimate for the whole loop. Meals stay separate.

On July 19, leave Conyers at 8:30 a.m. Eastern. Plan fuel and an early lunch near Tuscaloosa around 11:45 a.m. Central, another fuel and restroom stop near Jackson around 3:15 p.m., and a dinner break near Shreveport around 6:45 p.m. A reasonable Dallas arrival is 9:30 to 10:00 p.m. Central. The complete loop is roughly 2,250 road miles. At 25 mpg, that is about 90 gallons; using $3.05 per gallon gives a working fuel estimate of $275. That fits within the $302.51 left from the road allowance, leaving about $27.51 for fuel-price variation or small road costs. Meals remain excluded.
Please give me the final version in date order, with the one action I need to take before we leave.

Before July 11, call Courtyard Birmingham Hoover and obtain explicit confirmation that the room will be held for an arrival around 10:00 to 10:30 p.m. Central. July 11: leave Dallas at 9:30 a.m., stop near Shreveport, Jackson, and Meridian, and reach Hoover around 9:45 to 10:15 p.m. July 12: leave Hoover at 9:30 a.m. Central, stop near LaGrange and Augusta, and reach Hotel Folly around 6:15 to 6:45 p.m. Eastern; call Hotel Folly by 6:00 p.m. only if arrival will be after its 8:00 p.m. desk closure. July 18: check out by 11:00 a.m., eat lunch, leave around 12:30 p.m., stop near Columbia, and reach Conyers around 6:00 to 6:30 p.m. Eastern. July 19: leave Conyers at 8:30 a.m. Eastern, stop near Tuscaloosa, Jackson, and Shreveport, and reach Dallas around 9:30 to 10:00 p.m. Central. Remaining payments are $184.86 at the Courtyard, $1,318.24 plus $180 parking at Hotel Folly, and $162.63 at La Quinta, for $1,845.73 still due. Budget about $275 for fuel; meals are separate.
